name: open-design
description: Connect a supported local agent host to an OpenDesign workspace to read, create, and revise design artifacts through its existing MCP server. Requires the fork's built od CLI and a reachable OpenDesign daemon.

interface.longDescription: Work with OpenDesign projects and design artifacts through the existing local MCP server. This package requires the built od CLI on the agent host. Hosted web and mobile chats need a separately configured remote connection; uploading this package does not host OpenDesign.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenDesign to help me create or revise a design in my workspace.
